Projects.title: Projects
Projects.intro: Personal projects and case studies of systems I've built.

simi.name: SIMI
simi.description: Finance tracking for personal and travel expenses. A Rails 8 app with Phlex and RubyUI on the frontend, AI features powered by RubyLLM, storage on Cloudflare R2 and automated deploys with Kamal and GitHub Actions.

imagePipeline.name: Image processing pipeline
imagePipeline.description: Decoupled image processing from a Rails monolith, handling around 600 images per minute. Direct uploads to S3 through presigned URLs, fan-out with SNS and SQS, and Lambda services in Python and Ruby for resizing, fraud detection and AI integration.

vehicleLookup.name: Serverless vehicle lookup
vehicleLookup.description: Migrated vehicle lookup from a monolith to serverless Python microservices on AWS — API Gateway, Cognito, DynamoDB, SQS and SSM — with end-to-end observability through OpenTelemetry, OpenObserve and Grafana.
